## Schrödinger, Inc. (SDGR) `[Software & SaaS]`
- A September 23 technical-market report said SDGR had reached a two-year high of $31.59 on September 22; Barchart listed a 100% “Buy” technical opinion, analyst price targets ranging from $17 to $41.17, and short interest of 15.02% of the float (Barchart).
- A September 23 valuation article cited Schrödinger’s creation of Tectora and recent restricted-stock-unit grants as developments that could affect future drug-discovery programs and royalty streams; it also reported trailing-twelve-month free cash flow of negative $133.9 million (Simply Wall St).
- No company earnings release, SEC filing, contract announcement, or named analyst action explaining the September 23 decline was identified in the available results.

## Quantum Corporation (QMCO) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Quantum reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 adjusted EPS of $0.18 on revenue of $80.8 million, versus analyst estimates of a $0.17 loss per share and $75.05 million of revenue (MarketBeat).
- The company’s fiscal first-quarter 2027 results were also reported as $0.18 of adjusted EPS versus an expected $0.24 loss and $80.8 million of revenue versus an expected $71.5 million (Investing.com).
- Quantum’s shares reached a 52-week high of $27.82 on September 23 (Investing.com).
- Laura A. Nash left her positions as chief accounting officer and principal accounting officer effective September 1; Quantum said she would remain in a transition role through the end of 2026 and that there were no disagreements with the company (Investing.com).

## ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. (CHPT) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.

## Hyperliquid Strategies Inc. Common Stock (PURR) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.

## Forward Industries, Inc. (FWDI) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Forward Industries announced a registered direct offering of approximately $25 million to a single institutional investor at $8.00 per share (GlobeNewswire, as reported by Solana Compass).
- The offering consists of 3,125,000 common shares, with net proceeds allocated to purchases of Solana for the company’s treasury; closing was expected around September 24, 2026 (GlobeNewswire, as reported by Solana Compass).
- A September 23 market report said FWDI fell from a prior close of $8.60 to an opening price of $8.20 and traded near $8.3150 (MarketBeat).
- The registered direct offering was reported as the catalyst for the September 23 decline; the offering price was $8.00 per share (Solana Compass).

## CVR Energy, Inc. (CVI) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`

## AtriCure, Inc. (ATRC) `[Semiconductors]`
